jobs.title: Product Manager, Operations & Applied AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT VINYL EQUITY

 

We're building the next generation of capital-markets infrastructure, starting with a modern, digital-native transfer agent designed for today's public companies. Our platform replaces slow, manual processes with secure, automated workflows.

 

Backed by Index Ventures, Spark Capital, and Infinity Ventures, our team includes veterans from NYSE, Equiniti, Computershare, and AngelList.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

 

This position focuses on transforming multi-party workflows into products that are instrumented, guardrailed, self-serve, and AI-assisted. The role bridges three customer groups: Vinyl operators, issuers/shareholders, and market partners (DTC, law firms, banks, Broadridge). You'll set product direction alongside engineers without direct management responsibility. The role requires in-office presence at least three days weekly at the West Loop headquarters.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

 - Make Vinyl's operations AI-native. Build baseline metrics on operator effort, then apply human-in-the-loop AI to ingestion, mapping, support triage, and operator copilots

 - Own the requirements pipeline. Convert operator and issuer needs into build-ready specifications capturing domain facts, edge cases, and clear recommendations

 - Ship self-serve experiences for issuers and shareholders. Develop reporting, exports, and status views

 - Extend the platform to next workflows: tender offers, escheatment, unclaimed property, and disbursements

 - Instrument real-time visibility and accountability across multi-party processes

 - Design correctness and controls into the product: invariants, maker-checker approvals, and audit trails

 


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

 

 - 7+ years in product, program, or technical operations

 - Hands-on AI/ML deployment experience in product or operations contexts

 - Strong technical foundation: code literacy, integration understanding, model evaluation capability

 - Track record designing correctness and controls in regulated or high-stakes domains

 - Demonstrated ability reducing manual operational load without unnecessary process complexity

 - Proven ability measuring business impact and collaborating asynchronously

 


NICE TO HAVES

 

 - Fintech, regtech, or compliance-heavy environment experience

 - Familiarity with ReactJS, NextJS, NodeJS, AWS, GitHub

 - Team or function building experience

 - Operations-engineering, solutions-architect, or TPM background

 


BENEFITS

 

 - Target base salary: $130,000–$207,000 commensurate with experience

 - Equity-based compensation

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance

 - 401(k)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Hybrid work schedule (minimum 3 days/week in-office)

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Core TA & Corporate Actions
jobs.description:
ABOUT VINYL EQUITY

 

We're building the next generation of capital-markets infrastructure, starting with a modern, digital-native transfer agent designed for today's public companies. Our platform replaces slow, manual processes with secure, automated workflows.

 

Backed by Index Ventures, Spark Capital, and Infinity Ventures, our team includes veterans from NYSE, Equiniti, Computershare, and AngelList.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

 

Core Transfer Agency forms the foundation of Vinyl's platform, handling every share movement and value distribution. This domain-leader role requires substantive operational experience in transfer-agency and corporate-actions workflows. You will own transfers, issuances, cancellations, holder management, DRS, DWAC, restricted-security removal, dividends, distributions, spinoffs, escheatment, tax filings, tender offers, and warrant exercises end-to-end.

 

The role demands expertise in SEC 17Ad-17, Schedule TO mechanics, DEF 14A timing, DTC settlement workflows, and restricted-securities removal from lived experience. Requires 20% travel to Chicago and customer sites.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

 - Own the Core TA + Corporate Actions product roadmap

 - Own Tender Offer and Warrant Exercise as ongoing product lines, driving new deal types, deeper automation, and improved per-deal economics

 - Drive product evolution in reverse splits, rights offerings, escheatment, DWAC/DRS API switches

 - Partner with Core engineering tech leads on architecture, workflow design, and operational reliability

 - Engage directly with customers—general counsel, equity administrators, securities lawyers, corporate secretaries

 - Represent Core TA and Corporate Actions in sales conversations with prospective issuers

 - Collaborate with operations teams on workflow design, SLA definitions, and exception escalation

 - Represent Vinyl in regulator and DTC conversations on Core TA mechanics and settlement workflows

 - Define success metrics: transfer velocity, restricted-security removal time, corporate-action execution accuracy

 - Write product specifications, decision memos, regulator-facing artifacts, and customer playbooks

 


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

 

 - 8–12+ years in capital-markets infrastructure—transfer agent, clearing firm, custodian, broker-dealer back office

 - Personal operating depth in transfer agency and corporate actions

 - Working knowledge of SEC, DTC, and stock-exchange rules: SEC 17Ad-17, Schedule TO, DEF 14A/DEFA14A

 - Demonstrated track record shipping product or operational improvements in TA or corporate-actions

 - Technical comfort with architecture and cross-functional engineering collaboration

 - Strong customer-facing presence with counsel, lawyers, equity administrators

 - Capability participating in regulator and DTC conversations

 - Hands-on experience with AI/ML tools in product or operational settings

 - Comfort with 20% travel to Chicago and customer sites

 


NICE TO HAVES

 

 - Direct transfer-agent experience in product, operations, or domain-leader roles

 - Experience at clearing firms, custodians, or broker-dealer back offices

 - Tender Offer, Exchange Agent, or warrant exercise experience

 - KYC/KYB workflow familiarity

 - Tokenized securities, on-chain settlement, or stablecoin payment rails experience

 - Regulated-environment background: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR compliance

 


BENEFITS

 

 - Competitive base salary aligned with Indian Series A benchmarks

 - Equity-based compensation at Series A preferred price

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

 - Generous PTO

 - In-office collaborative Mangaluru environment with structured US travel
